newsitem.title: UK: UK gas claims agency recommends Coopers and Lybrand.
newsitem.headline: UK gas claims agency recommends Coopers and Lybrand.

text.p: Claims Validation Services Ltd (CVSL), the agency which verifies that quantities of natural gas have been delivered at the UK's beach gas terminals, has recommended that Coopers and Lybrand be awarded a contract to carry out claims validation services.

CVSL said in a statement that it would recommend to its approximately 60 members that a three year contract should be awarded. If approved it would start on 1 September and encompass all six UK gas terminals.

At present Coopers and the International Petroleum Exchange (IPE) each validate gas delivery claims at three terminals. Both submitted proposals for an upgraded service involving electronic transfer of claims data. But CVSL said that the recommendation to award the contract to Coopers was "strongly influenced by the need to give CVSL the best commercial deal possible over the term of the contract."

Claims Validation at beach terminals has been fraught with problems over recent months. The IPE's decision to base its inaugural natural gas futures contract at the National Balancing Point (NBP) rather than at the beach terminal of Bacton was due to continued validation problems which have so far made it impossible to trade futures at the beach.
